prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for a native macOS desktop companion.
Reference image: approved warm ivory and mint Ply character board. Preserve this exact cute identity: large softly rounded ivory head, friendly glossy dark eyes, tiny mouth, warm cheeks, little bean feet, mint seam between head and tiny base. The user loves the upper-left calm creature and upper-row second delighted tilted creature. Preserve that warmth. No angry expression, no sharply angled brows.

Render a production sprite atlas as one image with TRUE alpha transparency. Four columns and two rows of equal square cells. Landscape aspect ratio 2:1, ideally 2048 by 1024. Every cell contains one COMPLETE creature, including all feet and top pieces. Keep an empty transparent margin around each creature, at least 10 percent on every side. Keep the same camera, body scale, horizontal center, and foot baseline in every cell; the character occupies roughly 75 percent of the cell width and 72 percent of its height. No art crosses cell boundaries. Do not render the ivory background from the reference: all empty space must be transparent, without a white box, white fringe, specks, matte debris, checkerboard pattern or environmental floor. Only the actual character is opaque. No cast ground shadow.

Eight cells, reading order:
1. Rest: no top pieces, relaxed open eyes and tiny smile; two soft ivory levels with mint seam.
2. Noticed you / picked up: two tiny rounded top pieces, eager head tilt, delighted open-mouth smile and bright attentive eyes, feet softly tucked. Keep the cute upper-row second creature's expression.
3. Browsing: two very small rounded top pieces gently fan apart like curious ears, inquisitive sweet gaze. No symbols.
4. Arranging: three tiny rounded cushion blocks nest into a low balanced step, gentle proud curved smiling eyes.
5. Gentle focus: one small rounded top piece, calm round eyes looking slightly downward, tiny soft smile. NO brows or scowl.
6. Thinking: two small top pieces nest inward, head tilt, mildly thoughtful expression; sweet and engaged, not sad or irritated.
7. Question: one tiny top piece perked, one drooped, curious wide eyes and tiny round mouth; no question mark.
8. Happy landing: low nestled top pieces, joyful curved eyes, delighted tiny smile, one foot lifted a little.

All features, face, geometry, shading and lighting must be rendered together in the image model. No icons, labels, browser glyphs, pointers, question marks, text or added props. Keep the same character, not eight redesigns. Beautiful soft vinyl / porcelain, subtle warm highlights, polished character art. The result will float directly on arbitrary desktop backgrounds, so actual clean transparency is essential.
rendering: Only complete model-rendered frames; no added facial features, shapes, or icons.
